scope: Additional primary-source search for an untouched public station-to-vehicle HRS full-loop holdout

sources.title: Temperature Rise on Liner Surfaces of Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle Tanks during Fueling Process
sources.reported_scope: NREL HITRF fueling experiment with a 108 L vehicle surrogate, 6.3 to 73.0 MPa pressure rise over 186 s and measured gas/liner temperatures.
sources.finding: The public manuscript provides figures and boundary conditions but no downloadable synchronized logger export, channel dictionary or reuse terms.

sources.title: National Fuel Cell Technology Evaluation Center
sources.reported_scope: NLR/NREL processing of detailed operational, maintenance and safety data contributed by hydrogen technology partners.
sources.public_access_boundary: Raw partner data are secured; public products are aggregated composite data products.
sources.finding: The facility confirms a credible data custodian and request route, but it does not publish the synchronized station-to-vehicle logger files required by the frozen holdout rule.

sources.title: H2FillS: Hydrogen Filling Simulation
sources.reported_scope: Full-station and partial-station simulation software for vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow trajectories validated against empirical fueling data.
sources.public_access_boundary: Software download requires registration; the product page does not expose an independent raw empirical archive.
sources.finding: The simulator is useful for method comparison but its generated traces cannot serve as an independent measured holdout.

sources.title: Hourly hydrogen-station capacity dataset associated with Ramea et al.
sources.reported_scope: Three months of hourly California station-capacity/utilization observations.
sources.public_access_boundary: The article states that a dataset was released, but no working downloadable archive was located in the current repository/web search.
sources.finding: Even if recovered, hourly station capacity lacks vehicle/receptacle pressure, temperature and mass-flow traces and cannot close the thermodynamic full-loop gate.

sources.title: NIST Transient Flow Facility
sources.reported_scope: A metrology facility reproducing hydrogen dispenser pressure, temperature and flow transients for flow-meter testing.
sources.public_access_boundary: The public project page describes the facility and objectives but does not provide a downloadable station-to-vehicle logger archive.
sources.finding: This is a strong metrology request lead for flow uncertainty, but no public synchronized raw archive or reuse terms were found.

claim_boundary: These sources strengthen independent provenance and data-request coverage only. No source is promoted to numerical validation without a machine-readable synchronized export, immutable hash, frozen no-fitting scoring protocol and written reuse rights.
